intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes missing NV12 plane unlinking logic during the plane invisibility transition.
intent_record.what: Added a forward declaration for unlink_nv12_plane and inserted a call to this function at the start of intel_plane_set_invisible before clearing crtc_state plane bits.
intent_record.how: Ensures NV12 plane-specific cleanup logic executes when a plane transitions to invisible, maintaining state consistency and preventing stale references.

intent_record.intent_summary: Adds a null-pointer guard to unlink_nv12_plane to safely exit when no linked plane exists.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check at the beginning of unlink_nv12_plane to verify if plane_state->planar_linked_plane is NULL, returning early if true.
intent_record.how: Prevents execution of subsequent cleanup logic and state modifications when the linked plane reference is absent, avoiding potential errors from operating on invalid state.

intent_record.intent_summary: Removed redundant conditional check to ensure NV12 plane unlinking occurs unconditionally during atomic state validation
intent_record.what: Removed the conditional check 'if (plane_state->planar_linked_plane)' before calling unlink_nv12_plane(), making the function call unconditional
intent_record.how: The unlink_nv12_plane() function is now always executed for matching planes regardless of whether planar_linked_plane is set, ensuring consistent cleanup of NV12 plane links during atomic state validation
